description: This file defines a factory function to create and configure a SessionServerAppManager object, which manages session server applications within the rialto server manager component. It includes necessary headers, uses smart pointers for resource management, and constructs objects with specific parameters related to environment, paths, timeouts, and health check intervals.

methods.name: createSessionServerAppManager
methods.description: Factory function that creates and returns a unique pointer to an ISessionServerAppManager, configured with provided IPC controller, observer, environment variables, session server path, startup timeout, health check interval, and socket permissions.
